criterion: Org number must be 10 digits with a valid Luhn check digit; the VAT number is derived as SE + digits + 01
Only a member holding organisation.manage can save company details; any member can read them
A second organisation cannot claim a taken org number (409 org_number_taken), and a deleted organisation frees it
Fiscal year is 12 months, or shorter, or up to 18 months; end after start
Every change is audited with user and changed field names, never values
A settings page at /app/org/$orgId/uppgifter shows and saves the details
